description: This file defines a PHP class 'Filter' within the OpenCart e-commerce framework, specifically for the admin controller events. It handles tasks related to editing and deleting product filters by scheduling asynchronous tasks for product data updates.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A controller class for handling product filter edit and delete events within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: editFilter
methods.description: Handles the 'edit filter' event by scheduling tasks to update product data associated with the filter.

methods.name: deleteFilter
methods.description: Handles the 'delete filter' event by scheduling tasks to update product data associated with the filter.
